proof: run.ts JSON plus the verdict doc; run twice, attach both outputs.

envelope: Harness: tools/spikes/<dir>/ has its own package.json (exact pins); bun.lock and node_modules gitignored there (must_not_touch package.json and bun.lock = repo root only).
